tasks.title: Repair reliable idle edge retraction at the existing owner
tasks.objective: Reproduce why the packaged unpinned panel remains obstructive, isolate the stale engagement or rearm contract, and make the smallest owner-native repair with deterministic public-behavior proof.
tasks.outcome: Every idle expanded entry path yields to the compact edge target after bounded disengagement while active editing, drag, resize, menus, focus safety and explicit reveal remain intact.
acceptance: The fix changes the existing FloatingPanelController/policy owner rather than adding another panel, global monitor, polling loop or dependency.
The exact reproducer fails before the repair and passes afterward through a deterministic reducer/policy or actual-panel integration seam.
Active typing and pointer/resize/menu engagement do not collapse mid-action, and terminal events reliably rearm without sticky holds or duplicate deadlines.
sh scripts/check.sh passes with warnings-as-errors, core, integration, Release render and package-contract checks.

verification.proves: The regression and full Cue behavior suite pass at the implementation boundary.
The retained AppKit panel honors the corrected retraction contract.

tasks.title: Package, restart and qualify the exact edge build
tasks.objective: Adversarially verify the repaired behavior on the real packaged window, record the exact build identity, restart Cue from dist, push the closed commits and close the tracker lifecycle.
tasks.outcome: The running Cue process points to the signed committed package, retracts in the user's actual flow, remains reachable, and origin/main contains small reviewable commits with Tracker evidence.
acceptance: The signed Release package passes Info.plist and executable identity checks and is launched from dist/Cue.app.
A real-window probe covers initial outside-pointer retraction, hover reveal, click/shortcut reveal, text edit then disengage, Panel Pin, drag/resize safety and compact-edge reachability.
The running process path and executable hash are recorded, the implementation commit is pushed to origin/main, and unresolved hardware-only coverage is named rather than implied.

verification.proves: The final packaged source tree remains fully green.
The real AppKit window and packaged process satisfy the unobtrusive edge behavior.
Feature task, gate and continuation truth are hash-bound.
